description: A new claim link for your person. Makes a fresh claim link for an unclaimed site, from its results link's token, when you hand it over or your person lost theirs. Needs no key. (POST /start/s/{token}/claim)

token.description: The results link's token (sr_…): the end of the `results` link POST /start answered. Private: never post it or send it to another site
